chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Yahya Al-Halabi, from his uncle Ubaydullah, that he said:

A man asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and I was present, so he said, 'I performed Umrah in the Sacred Months, and now I have arrived as a Mutamatti' (one who combines Umrah and Hajj). So I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying, 'Good is what you have done. We do not compromise with the Book of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). So when our Lord resurrects us, or we return to our Lord, we shall say: 'O Lord! We held fast to Your Book and the Sunnah of Your Prophet (peace be upon him and his family),' and the people would say, 'We followed our own opinions.' So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will deal with us and with them as He wills.'

key_terms.سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah
key_terms.مُتَمَتِّعاً: as a Mutamatti (combining Umrah and Hajj)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the Imams' adherence to the Quran and Sunnah versus the people's reliance on opinion?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi’s chapter on Hajj, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the theological foundation for the Mut'ah pilgrimage, contrasting the Ahl al-Bayt’s strict adherence to the Quran and Sunnah with the general populace’s reliance on personal opinion (ra'y). It underscores the Shia doctrine that the Imams’ actions are divinely guided and will be vindicated on the Day of Judgment, where they will declare, 'We held fast to Your Book and the Sunnah of Your Prophet,' while others will be judged by their own reasoning.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Al halby, from his uncle Ubeydullah who said,

‘A man asked Abu Abdullahasws and I was present, so he said, ‘I performed Umra in the Sacred Months, and now I am proceeding for performing Tamatto ’. So I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying, ‘Good is what you are doing. Weasws do not compromise with the Book of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic and Sunnah of Rasool-Allahsaww. So when ourasws Lordazwj Resurrects usasws, or weasws return to ourasws Lordazwj, weasws shall say: ‘O Lordazwj! We took by Yourazwj Book and Sunnah of Yourazwj Prophetsaww’, and the people would say, ‘We opined by our opinions’. So Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic would Deal with usasws and with them, however Heazwj so Desires to’.
en.sarwar: 12. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ibn Muskan from ‘Abd al-Malik ibn ‘Amr who has said the following:

“He once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about al-Hajj al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous). He (the Imam) said, ‘Perform al-Hajj al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous).’ It happened that he (the Imam) that year or next year performed Mufrid kind of al-Hajj and I asked him saying , ‘I pray to Allah to keep you well, I asked you about al-Hajj and you instructed me to perform al-Hajj al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous); and I see you perform Mufrid kind of al-Hajj.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘By Allah, goodness is in the kind of al-Hajj I told you to perform. I however, have become weak and performing Tawaf twice between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah, thus, I made it Mufrid kind of al-Hajj.’”
